description: Join Megan Coy as we canvass Olmsted Falls at the Olmsted Falls Library at noon on August 29th. Even if you have no experience canvassing, all are welcome! Our team will help train you to door knock in this extremely pivotal race in Cuyahoga County.

title: Olmsted Falls Canvass Launch! — Megan Coy
